instruction: A candid action photograph captures a full shot from a low angle in a bright, minimalist indoor dance studio. The female ballet dancer in a black long-sleeved top and white tutu (R1) is in the foreground with her back to the camera, lifting one leg in a pose. Beside her, the male ballet dancer in a black unitard (R2) stands on the left, holding her raised hand overhead. Bright, diffused light fills the white-walled space.
